mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% for two consecutive months predicts a near-term monetary tightening anticipation, which compresses equity discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% and remains > 0.3% for two consecutive months
regime_hint: rising inflation surprise in a restrictive policy environment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the triggered period (t-test p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL reverts below 0.3% within one month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS labor market additions, accompanied by UNRATE falling below 4%, signals a strengthening labor market that raises consumer confidence and equity valuations, producing positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases for three consecutive months and UNRATE < 4% for two consecutive months
regime_hint: labor market strengthening in a low-unemployment environment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered windows, or the labor momentum reverses (PAYEMS decelerates) before 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST retail sales of more than 2% followed by a rebound above the prior month's low predicts a near-term demand recovery that drives positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST drops > 2% for two consecutive months then rises > prior low in the third month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative during the recovery window, or HOUST does not exceed the prior low within 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly contraction in INDPRO manufacturing index (decline > 5%) accompanied by a simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS above 5% signals supply-side weakness and policy tightening, which produces negative 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 5% in a month when FEDFUNDS rises above 5%
regime_hint: supply contraction coinciding with aggressive monetary policy
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the contraction month, or INDPRO recovers within one trading day.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RSAFS commercial loan demand of at least 10% over two consecutive months, in the absence of a parallel rise in CPIAUCSL inflation, predicts a prolonged risk-off environment that drives negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 10% for two consecutive months and CPIAUCSL does not rise > 0.2% during the same period
regime_hint: looming credit cycle stress without price inflation
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered windows, or RSAFS recovers > 5% within one month.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3% for three consecutive months and PAYEMS remains flat or increases, it indicates a labor market cooling that reduces wage growth expectations and produces negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3% for three consecutive months and PAYEMS does not increase for two consecutive months
regime_hint: labor market moderation in a low-inflation environment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the cooling period, or PAYEMS accelerates above trend.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in FEDFUNDS above 5.25% for four consecutive months in a non-inflationary regime (CPIAUCSL < 0.2%) predicts a forward discounting effect that yields negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5.25% for four consecutive months and CPIAUCSL < 0.2% for the same period
regime_hint: high-rate environment with low price inflation
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the high-rate window, or CPIAUCSL exceeds 0.2% in any month during the period.

mechanism_narrative: A two-for-one combination of a monthly drop in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 1% and a simultaneous rise in HOUST retail sales above prior month's low predicts a demand bounce that drives positive 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls > 1% in a month when HOUST rises > prior month's low
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05) during the recovery window, or GDPC1 does not show a durable weakness (decline < 1% in the following month).
